Eye Pattern - Void Sclera.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Void Sclera
Deep, empty darkness replacing the whites of the eyes — blacker than black, as if the eye opens into a void.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Void Sclera.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply void-dark sclera so the whites of the eyes appear deep black or abyssal while the iris remains readable. This is eye appearance only; do not create shadow powers or supernatural fear effects.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
